credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Georgia O'Keeffe dressed in a white headscarf, white jacket, and a skirt walking on an illuminated pathway in the shadows of the canyon. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Walking in Canyon
